name: ainra-verifier-kit
description: Become an independent AINRA verifier: verify a passport with the root dark, reject a revoked and a forged one, and emit a signed attestation. Uses ONLY the published @ainra/sdk.
comment: A stranger installs the PUBLISHED package instead: replace the dependency with "@ainra/sdk": "^0.1.0" and `npm install`. The kit imports only @ainra/sdk's public Verifier — never any internal crate or the sdk source.
